items.lang|foxablazeaqzl_wiki|foxablazeaqzl_wi:
A silver formula of ice and water magic, creating ice clones that assist casting and using Diamond Dust to amplify later ice and water damage.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Split-Second Chant: Increases magic casting speed. Ice and Water magic gain a stronger casting speed bonus and deal more damage.

[Active - Toggle] Formula Succession: While active, Ars Weiss clones copy certain magic the user is about to cast and cast it as well. The copied spell uses the user's magic instance. With Mastery, continued magic keeps its full power.

[Passive - In Slot] Diamond Dust: Albis Vina attacks apply Diamond Dust. Targets with Diamond Dust take increased Ice and Water damage from the user. Mastery increases the bonus.

[Passive] Ice Sovereignty: Grants resistance to Ice and Water damage, and prevents the user from being slowed by their own ice effects.

Active
[Active - Press] Ars Weiss: Creates ice clones as dummy casting bodies. The clones copy the player's skin, but cannot attack normally, gain EP, or drop items, and disappear after a short duration. Mastery creates more clones and extends their duration. If a clone is destroyed, it bursts and applies Diamond Dust to nearby enemies.

[Active - Hold] Riville Calantibium: Fires a concentrated ice beam in the direction the user is looking. The beam pierces multiple targets, deals Ice damage, and applies Diamond Dust. If Ars Weiss clones are active, clones can also fire weaker beams from their own positions; with Mastery, all active clones can join.

[Active - Hold] Stellas Natea: Summons crystalline ice spears above the targeted area. The spears fall after a short delay, dealing Ice damage and slowing enemies hit. Targets with Diamond Dust are struck by an extra spear; active clones add weaker extra spears, and Mastery reduces the delay.

Learns from incoming attacks, gradually building the matching resistance and adapting to severance damage.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Adaption: When hit by any attack, gains a small amount of learning progress toward the matching resistance. If no matching resistance exists, builds damage reduction against that damage type, with a higher cap after Mastery.

[Passive - Toggle] Severance Adaption: After being hit by severance attacks multiple times, grants severance immunity and cancels future severance damage.

Active
[Active - Press] Summon Extermination Blade: Summons the Extermination Blade into the user's current inventory slot. It will not summon if a blade is already in the inventory or if the selected slot is occupied.

The authority of the Lord of Pestilence, elevating Fungus Infection into gray ooze, plague spread, and biomass absorption.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] The Gray Ooze Aura: The user emits ash-gray spores and mycelium. In combat, a living gray film coats the ground beneath them; enemies stepping onto it are afflicted with poison, corrosion, and fragility, which can stack through repeated exposure.

[Passive - Toggle] Biomass Absorption: When infected enemies take plague tick damage, part of their lifeforce is converted into biomass and returned to the user. The more infected targets are active, the stronger the user's regeneration becomes.

[Passive - Toggle] The Blight Carrier: Infected enemies become walking hazards. When they approach their allies, the plague jumps to clean targets, spreading poison, corrosion, and fragility through the enemy line.

Active
[Active - Press] Epidemic Sequencing Sweep: Works like Analyze, but scans an area to copy effects and gain more upgrade points.

[Active - Press] The Mutation Vault: Opens the Mutation Vault, functioning as an enhanced Workshop with more effect slots.

[Active - Press] Fungal Catalyst: Standing cast releases a wave of gray filth, applying slotted effects to nearby enemies. Crouching expands the wave, buffs the user with stored beneficial effects, and prevents stored debuffs from affecting the user.

[Active - Press] Fleshy Miscreations: Sacrifices part of the user's health and Magicules to tear away biomass and spawn fleshy doubles. These minions rush enemies and inject effects stored in the Mutation Vault. If they survive to the end, they dissolve and heal the user.

Enters Limbo at the cost of death, blindly choosing one skill owned by the direct killer and inheriting it permanently.

Passive
[Passive] Limbo: When the user dies, they enter a threshold space known as Limbo. A set of skill cards appears before the user, representing skills owned by the entity directly responsible for the user's death.

Card colors reveal only the skill tier:
Bronze: Common Skill.
Silver: Extra Skill or Intrinsic Skill.
Gold: Unique Skill.

[Passive] Blind Choice Restriction: The user may select only one card based on its color. The exact skill information associated with each card is completely hidden and cannot be identified, inferred, or revealed by bypassing the restriction in any way.

[Passive] Candidates and Inheritance: Only skills owned by the entity that directly killed the user enter the candidate list. At most one skill can be acquired from each death. After making a choice, the user revives at their respawn point and permanently acquires the selected skill.

[Passive] Enemy-Type Limit: For each enemy type, the user can enter Limbo through this effect at most once.

Usurp your enemies' Aura. Steal their abilities and control their skills, draining their power for your own use.

Passive
[Passive - While Equipped]: The player's attacks have a 50% chance to steal 1% of the target's Aura, restoring the player's depleted Aura.

Active
[Active - Press]: Overwrite: Copies one Battlewill skill from the target. Has a 25% success rate, increased to 50% when mastered. Each attempt costs 1,000 Magicules and has a 10-second cooldown.

Triples all physical capabilities, but can only be applied to opponents whose abilities are inferior to the user's.

[Press]: When targeting an opponent with lower EP than the user, attacking them will deal triple damage, including both physical and magical damage. The opponent's attacks against the user will also have their defensive resistance reduced to one-third, effectively allowing the user to withstand three times the normal damage.

Duration: 1 minute. After the duration ends, the skill enters a 120-second cooldown.

[Press]: Sends the player back to the moment when the world was first generated. The player's inventory, items, and other player data will be preserved. Only the world itself will be reset. This skill is disabled in multiplayer mode.

While possessing this skill, after killing a creature:

[Press]: Open the Summoning Panel and summon previously slain creatures. The number of Dark Avatars that can be summoned is limited to a maximum of 5. Once a Dark Avatar is killed or disappears, it cannot be summoned again and will be permanently gone. Killing a Dark Avatar will not grant the player EP or other rewards. Dark Avatars do not drop experience or loot.

By my barrier, I shall reverse the laws of your magicules, returning them to their elemental form. Thus, no magic shall be able to penetrate it.

Unlock Method: Master Anti-Magic Area to unlock Anti-Magic Barrier in its Learnable state.

Active [Hold]: Creates a magic field centered on the player that expands outward in all directions. Creatures inside the barrier will be restricted, while creatures outside cannot enter the magical barrier. Undead creatures within the barrier take 40 damage per second.

Cost: 1,000 Magicules per second.

A mysterious ritual that overturns the law of day and night, causing the holy and demonic to exchange places.

Acquisition:
Obtained when the player kills Luminous Valentine.

Active:
[Press]: Converts Majin Alignment into Holy Alignment, or Holy Alignment into Majin Alignment.

Cooldown: 1,800 seconds.

A mysterious ritual that overturns the law of day and night, causing the holy and demonic to exchange places.

Acquisition:
Master Reverser + possess Day-Night Inversion (will lose Day-Night Inversion).

Active:
[Press]: Converts Majin Alignment into Holy Alignment, or Holy Alignment into Majin Alignment.

Cooldown: 600 seconds.

Active
[Active - Hold] Soul Gluttony: Aim at a target and hold the skill key to devour its body, energy, and soul, converting the target into the player's MP, Magicules, or EP.
Powerful targets with more than 100 health must first be severely wounded, with only 10% health remaining, before they can be devoured.
Costs 5,000 Magicules. Both the individual and group modes have no cooldown (0 seconds).
Once mastered, killing enemies in the Nihility Collapse mode triggers Soul Gluttony, with strong penetration against barriers and Anti-Skill defenses.

[Active - Hold] Nihility Collapse: Hold the skill key to accumulate void energy. Longer charging increases the release strength, up to a maximum charge duration of 60 seconds. Release the key to unleash it.
While holding a weapon, damage equals the release damage + 10% of the weapon's damage.
Costs 50,000 Magicules. Cooldown: 300 seconds at full charge; partial charges scale the cooldown proportionally, rounded up to the next whole second.

[Active - Press] Imaginary Space: Provides 20 pages of storage, increased to 30 pages when mastered.

[Active - Press] Space-Time Domination: Use Shift + the skill key to switch sub-modes.
Instant Movement, Space-Time Connection (portal), and avatar teleportation all have a 5-second cooldown.
Mode A: Instant Movement
Move to a location within sight.
Move to the location of the player's avatar.
Mode B: Space-Time Connection

[Active - Press] True Dragon Release:
Mode A: Scorching Avatar
Attacks with fire and high-temperature skills.
Increases attack speed.
Strengthens scorching skills.
Suited to continuous attacks and fast combat.
Mode B: Storm Avatar
Attacks with wind, lightning, and storm skills.
Improves mobility.
Strengthens area attacks.
Suited to fighting groups.
Mode C: White Ice Avatar
Attacks with freezing and slowing skills.
Reduces enemy movement speed.
Strengthens defense.
Suited to controlling the battlefield.

[Active - Press] True Dragon Nucleation: Coming soon.

Passive
Multidimensional Barrier:
Provides resistance to physical attacks, immunity to fire, and resistance to elemental attacks.
Greatly reduces damage from physical attacks, elemental magic attacks, and projectile attacks.
Provides high damage reduction against Ultimate Skill attacks.
